 3 dead after airplane goes down near north rim of Grand Canyon
 The Piper Comanche was reported missing to the Grand Canyon Regional Communications Center around 11:30 p.m. on Sunday.
 BY KYLIE WERNER 
 Nov 16, 2026, 6:27 PM

 Three people are dead after their plane was reported missing and then found downed near the north rim of the Grand Canyon, the National Park Service announced Monday.
 The aircraft and debris field were found in the Basin area around 10:15 a.m., according to NPS .
 The Piper Comanche was reported missing to the Grand Canyon Regional Communications Center around 11:30 p.m. on Sunday. Its last known location was not far from the Basin area on the North Rim.
 The National Transportation Safety Board is working to determine what caused the plane to go down.
 The people who died are not being identified for privacy reasons.
 The Arizona Department of Public Safety, Coconino County Search and Rescue, Kane County Search and Rescue and Air Force Rescue Coordination Center helped with the search efforts.
